ideas.title: Ilhan Omar's Involvement in Potential Fraudulent Activities
ideas.description: This story would investigate Rep. Ilhan Omar's involvement in potential fraudulent activities and her decision to skip a fraud hearing.
ideas.angle: The demand for records by Minnesota lawmakers and the implications of Rep. Omar's actions.
questions: What are the details of Rep. Omar's involvement in potential fraudulent activities?
Why did she skip the fraud hearing?
ideas.insight: This story has significant implications for Rep. Omar's reputation and could potentially lead to further investigations.

ideas.title: The Prevalence of Identity Theft in the US
ideas.description: This story would investigate the prevalence of identity theft in the US, using the semi driver in the deadly I-71 crash as a case study.
ideas.angle: The use of fraudulent IDs in the I-71 crash and potential connections to larger organized crime schemes.
questions: What are the most common types of identity theft in the US?
How prevalent is identity theft in different industries?
ideas.insight: This story could provide valuable insights into the prevalence of identity theft and potential ways to prevent it.
